relations.quote: Like the [Discrete Fourier transform and butterflies](dft-fft.md), a synthetic transform computes its transforms by butterfly levels: each level combines pairs of entries into their sum and their difference, after multiplying one of them by a power of $y$.
Synthetic polynomial transforms work over the [Polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$](poly-ring-y-r.md), where $y^r=-1$.
